prompt.adult: Revelation 5:5 calls Jesus the Lion of which tribe?

verses.text: But one of the elders said to me, "Do not weep. Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the scroll and to loose its seven seals."

explanation.adult: The elder in Revelation 5:5 says "the Lion of the tribe of" and then names a tribe. Read that tribe and choose it.

teaching.extended_explanation: Revelation 5:5 comforts John and names the one who can open the scroll. Levi, Benjamin, and Dan are tribes of Israel, but they are not the tribe in this verse. Read the tribe that follows "Lion of the tribe of".
teaching.takeaway: Jesus is called the Lion of the tribe of Judah.
